description: This file manages session transcript operations including resolving session files, appending assistant messages, and handling idempotency keys within a session management system.

methods.name: ensureSessionHeader
methods.description: Ensures that a session header exists in the specified session file, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveSessionTranscriptFile
methods.description: Resolves the file path and session entry for a given session, optionally persisting session data.

methods.name: appendAssistantMessageToSessionTranscript
methods.description: Appends an assistant message to the session transcript, handling idempotency and session file management.

methods.name: transcriptHasIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Checks if a transcript already contains a message with the specified idempotency key.
